args.body:
Dear Contoso Team,

Your requested refund of **$175** for the incorrect early-renewal charge has been processed successfully. The funds will be delivered within **3–5 business days** (standard banking timelines apply).

**Details:**
- **Reason**: Auto-renewal in the wrong month (Policy COYH).
- **Reference**: Contract C-3293, Renewal Month: January (Cycle-of-Year-Hold).
- **Action Taken**: Refund applied; CRM record archived per **Retention Policy RP-14**.

To avoid future issues, ensure your billing settings align with the **contracted renewal month (January)**. Contact us if discrepancies recur.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
